summary: Join our comprehensive training on Practical Planning and Technical Project Management. Equip yourself with essential skills for effective project delivery.
lede: Practical project management training helps professionals who plan, deliver or oversee projects define clear objectives, scope, schedules and budgets. It also covers assessing project risks, tracking progress and costs with practical measures, and communicating with stakeholders so teams can identify problems and make informed adjustments.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals tasked with planning, delivering, or overseeing projects who need both practical and technical project management skills.
audience: Project managers and project engineers in public
PMO staff and project support teams
modules: Project Economic Evaluation and Business Justification
Time Planning, Scheduling, and Critical Path
Cost Estimating, Budgeting, and Cash Flow
Monitoring, Control, and Earned Value in Plain Language
Project Closure, Learning, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management principles and some experience in managing or supporting projects.
